subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
MOD-32 up counter has starting state (00110)2 and
MOD-16 down counter has starting state (0110)2.
Application of 75 clock pulses up counter is in state
M and down counter is in state N then value of M +
N is _(__)10___.
[MCQ]
explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-11 (Sequential Circuits (Part - 4)).
